content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyRxIndication_<CGI> API ex- ists within an Rte_COMCbkRxIndication callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyRxIndication_<CGI> call: • PduInfoPtr The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyRxIndication_<CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COMCbkRxIndication callback.
